notes.title: Patch 1.3 is live now!
notes.content:
Pilots!

Today is a big day for [i]Kamikaze Lassplanes[/i]. The game has just been released on the [url=https://store-jp.nintendo.com/item/software/D70010000087570]Japanese eShop[/url] and is now available for Japanese players on Nintendo Switch! We're continuing to work on making it available in other regions, but to celebrate today's launch, we've prepared a major update for you.

We’re constantly working on bringing the game to as many languages as possible, and we’re happy to announce that [i]Kamikaze Lassplanes is now available in Simplified Chinese[/i]! We hope that this update will allow Alba and Hanna’s adventure to reach a brand-new audience of players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44059914/2b8521b344344f68b83000cead77fd6aec64a4d6.png[/img]

At the same time, we’ve introduced a new feature designed especially for our Streamer community.
[i]By enabling the Streamer Mode option in the settings menu, you can now stream the game on even the most restrictive platforms without any issues![/i] Streamer Mode activates a more SFW version of the game’s illustrations.

Additionally, the patch fixes several issues related to the other language versions of the game and includes small tweaks to further improve Kamikaze Lassplanes.

As always, we look forward to your feedback and comments!

Thank you for playing!
Inky Dreams Crew

[h1]1.3 Changelog:[/h1]

[h2]⚒ Improvements[/h2]
- Simplified Chinese added as a language option;
- Streamer Mode added

[h2]⚒ Bugfixes[/h2]
- Fixed language-related bugs;
- Addressed several minor bugs

notes.title: Official Discord Server
notes.content:
Hey pilots!

We've decided to create a small discord server for fans of the game to help connect members of our community. This server is dedicated to all things Kamikaze Lassplanes. You can talk about your experience with the game, share some tips or ask for help with getting different endings, as well as post content you've created about it.

If you want to chat with the developers, report a bug you've encountered or share feedback to help make this game better, we, devs from Inky Dreams will be waiting for you there. ːsteamhappyː

You can pick a [b]different role[/b] depending on your favorite character and receive a special color. We've also created emojis you can use in, as well as outside of the server!

[url=https://discord.gg/NR62hAXTz4]
Click to see your invitation to Sky Fortress[/url]

[h2]RULES:[/h2]
[h3]Be respectful[/h3]
We want everyone to feel welcome and comfortable. Respect each other and the mods. Be polite and keep it friendly and positive. Don't get involved with arguments or post inflammatory statements.

Hate speech and verbal abuse of server members will not be tolerated.

[h3]Don't spoil the surprise[/h3]
Please contain spoilers for the game in a dedicated ⁠#spoiler-discussions channel if you wish to freely discuss the plot of the game. If you choose to share them in any other channel, please tag them with spoiler tags (||message||) so the new players can avoid them easily.

[h3]Off-topic[/h3]
Do not discuss politics or religion in the social channels. We're an ecchi visual novel, so we understand a thin line we're walking on. However, NSFW content is not permitted on this server.

[h3]Self promotion[/h3]
If you're a content creator, you can share links to your youtube videos and livestreams in the #lp-and-livestreams channel.

notes.title: PAX East 2024 Gameplay Demo
notes.content:
Come to PAX East and brace yourself for an extraordinary journey with Kamikaze Lassplanes!

[h3]VISIT OUR BOOTH AT PAX EAST [/h3]
From today until Sunday, you can play the gameplay demo and meet us at the convention in Boston, where script writer Patrycja and game director Norman will be present to answer all your game-related questions. 

[h3]PICK YOUR LASSPLANE IN A NEW STEAM DEMO[/h3]
But if Boston isn't on your route, worry not! We have prepared a unique Steam gameplay demo for you! In the brief scenarios specially prepared for PAX, you'll discover the combat capabilities of [b]both Lassplanes[/b] and choose your favorite! The Steam PAX Gameplay Demo will only be available until Sunday, so download and check it out today!

PS. The demo includes a series of enhancements that you suggested to us during the Steam Next Fest. We're looking forward to hear how do you like the changes!
